issues.detail: The skill does not cover error handling for token expiration or network failures, limiting robustness.
The instructions include verbose explanations that could be trimmed for brevity.
The skill assumes Node.js and Salesforce CLI, limiting applicability to agents without these environments.

scenarios.name: composite-create-account-contact-opportunity
scenarios.rationale: Both responses fully satisfy the rubric, providing a POST to /composite with allOrNone:true, a compositeRequest array containing an Account and a Contact that references it via @{referenceId.id}, and using the API_VERSION variable in the URLs.

scenarios.name: bulk-api-upsert-contacts
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets all rubric requirements exactly, while Response A uses POST instead of PUT for the batch upload, missing a rubric requirement.

scenarios.name: apex-trigger-create-task-high-value
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets all rubric requirements, while Response B fails to set ActivityDate to Date.today().addDays(3).
